== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The frozen horn is a unique artifact originally taken from [[Helgard]] by [[Valin]], who subsequently attuned it to [[Valinhall]]. Unlike traditional metal horns used for signaling alerts, this object is constructed from blown glass and frosted ice, featuring a central tube containing moving [[water]]. When sounded, it produces a single, clear, crystalline note that resonates powerfully without being harsh to the listener. The primary function of the horn is to close [[Gates]]. While it can be used manually, this method is less efficient, requiring over an hour to recharge between uses. Alternatively, the horn's power can be summoned into a [[sword]], allowing the ability to recover within seconds. There is only one such horn in existence; once summoned, it cannot be used by anyone else until the current user relinquishes it.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The frozen horn is an artifact composed of blown glass and frosted ice that contains a moving puddle of [[water]] within its exterior. Recognized as a potential Valinhall powers{{!}}Valinhall power, this object possesses the specific ability to close [[Gates]]. During his journey, [[Simon]] manages to channel the power of the horn through his [[sword]].}}
